notes: Baymiller is printed bare 'BAYMILLER' (sheet 39 also). Centres from block faces: Freeman faces ~x707-720 / 907-925 (pipes at ~780 and ~830 are not centred), Baymiller faces ~3280 / 3460. West 8th: only the south face is on the sheet (y~322-327), centre computed 100 px north of it for the printed 60 ft (y~223, on the paper which starts at y~185). West 6th printed 66': north face y~4392-4417, centre computed 110 px south. Baymiller is printed 47' near 6th (50' at 8th). Van Horne, Barr and Kenyon start at Freeman (west side is sheet 37: block or rail yard), so they are T from the east. Hathaway (no width printed here, 40' on sheet 39) and Wingate Alley (20', named on sheet 39; centre y~4013 between faces 3981/4045) appear only east of Baymiller at the sheet edge and are T there; west of Baymiller is the C.H.&D. freight yard. Freeman crosses the rail yard between Kenyon and 6th (iron bridge on sheet 37) with no intersections.
